H01.bug: Reset is synchronous instead of asynchronous, delaying reset effects until a clock edge.

H02.bug: Addition accidentally includes a carry-in of one, so every computed sum is incremented.

H03.bug: Subtraction uses the addition operator, producing the wrong result in subtraction mode.

H04.bug: The negative-result condition in the subtraction overflow check is inverted.

H05.bug: Clear zeroes the output but fails to return the state machine to IDLE.

H06.bug: Captures operand A into both operand registers, so the computed sum or difference uses the wrong second operand.

H07.bug: Adds an unintended carry-in of one during addition.

H08.bug: Uses the wrong sign condition for the second operand in the subtraction overflow calculation.

H09.bug: Only honors clear when enable is also asserted, so a clear request can be ignored.

H10.bug: Stays in OUTPUT when enable is low instead of returning to IDLE, delaying completion until enable is asserted.
